services.name: Commercial glazing
services.summary: Shopfronts, entries and full-height glass for commercial fitouts.
includes: Manual and automatic glass entry doors

faq.q: Do you work on occupied commercial sites?
faq.a: Yes. Most of our work is in operating offices, shops and warehouses. Glass is measured outside working hours where needed, and installations are staged around your trading or staff hours.

faq.q: Can you match existing shopfront framing?
faq.a: Usually. Send a photo and a couple of dimensions when you enquire and we can tell you before anyone visits whether the existing frame takes new glass or whether the frame needs replacing too.
Yes — the certificate identifies the glass, the make-up, the standard it was selected under (AS 1288) and the installer. It is issued for the job, not copied from a template.
The person who quotes measures. That is deliberate: a quote built on someone else's measurements is a quote for a different job.

services.name: Office partitions
services.summary: Framed, frameless and demountable glass partition systems.
includes: Glass and timber doors, patch fittings, closers
Manifestation and privacy film to AS 1428 sight lines

faq.q: Can partitions be added while we keep working?
faq.a: Usually yes. Partition glazing is staged in sections, and the noisiest work — cutting, drilling, silicone — is scheduled before hours or in a defined window.

faq.q: Do I need consent or a permit?
faq.a: That depends on the building and whether the work touches base build services, fire systems or egress. We will tell you when a partition run is likely to need building approval before we quote it.

faq.q: Can I reuse partitions when I move?
faq.a: If they were built demountable. A frameless system is generally fixed to the tenancy — worth deciding at the start.

services.name: Shower screens
services.summary: Frameless and semi-frameless screens, measured and installed.

faq.q: Do you measure before or after tiling?
faq.a: After. Screen dimensions need the finished tile face and floor fall, so measuring happens once tiling and waterproofing are complete.

faq.q: Can you replace just the glass?
faq.a: Often — if the hinges and brackets are reusable and the opening has not moved. Send a photo of the hardware and the screen and we will tell you.

faq.q: How long between measure and install?
faq.a: Typically one to two weeks, because toughened glass has to be cut, drilled and heat-treated to your exact dimensions. Confirm the date at quote.

services.name: Glass replacement
services.summary: Broken windows, doors and shopfronts — make safe and replace.
includes: Upgrade to safety glass where required

faq.q: Can you make it safe today?
faq.a: Most days, yes — board-up or removal of loose glass can usually be arranged the same day across Melbourne metro. Call rather than email for anything unsafe.
Depends on your policy. We photograph the damage, note the make-up replaced and provide an invoice you can submit.

faq.q: The old glass was thinner — do I have to upgrade?
faq.a: If the location now requires safety glass, yes. A glazier replacing glass in a regulated location is bound by AS 1288 regardless of what was there before.

services.name: Wardrobes & mirrors
services.summary: Mirror wardrobe doors, splashbacks and wall mirrors.

faq.q: Can you replace mirror only, keeping the tracks?
faq.a: Often yes, if the track is sound and the door size is standard. Photograph the track and the top roller and we can advise.
Where they could be struck or where Council or a spec calls for it. In gyms and bathrooms we default to safety-backed.
